message: 25F. I got my STI panel results in the portal and I don't understand what one of the values means. Can someone explain?

queries: STI panel results interpretation normal abnormal
sexually transmitted infection test positive negative values

output.reason: Information request about test result interpretation; no acute clinical need or necessary clinician task identified.

A 25-year-old asks for interpretation of a specific STI panel value, which requires a clinician to review the actual result and advise on any treatment, without any reported symptoms requiring in-person assessment.
output.patientMessage: A Counsel clinician can review your STI panel in this thread and explain what that value means, including whether any treatment or repeat testing is needed; please share the result name and number. If you develop fever, pelvic or belly pain, genital sores, or unusual discharge before you hear back, seek same-day medical care.
